column1: # The game's own Xbox One button icons in place of its Switch ones, for the porter's Xbox layout (config pad_layout xbox, porter/xbox_icons.py). The Switch release
# still carries the Xbox One set (camel/ui/images/icons/buttons/durango), stored uncompressed in the same archive slice as the Switch set (buttons/nx). Each row
# re-encodes one Xbox icon (64x64 like the Switch one) to fit a Switch icon's place byte for byte, so the slice's table of contents stays right; the patched
# slice goes into the pack's romfs_patch folder, which the host reads before the RomFS (DM_ROMFS_OVERLAY). The game's X is the top button, an Xbox
# controller's Y, so its X icons show Y and its Y icons X (DM_PAD_XBOX=ab keeps X and Y in their places). The d-pad, stick-click and + (start) icons stay:
# the Switch ones already match. Places from the archive's _DataPartList.txt (each checked: a PNG starts there and ends in IEND), MD5s of the v327680 RomFS.
